_comment: THE pricing seed: the only place in the repo where a SortMyCover price is typed (3.6). Loaded into the Postgres `pricing` table by `node automation/billing/pricing.js --sql`. Every other surface reads the table. Values from MASTER-PROMPT 3.5. active_from stays null until Jonathan approves the ladder (Section 8 Q5); W25 renders unapproved rows only in staging. media_share_zar = the 3.5 'Media @ R200 CPL (incl. VAT)' column as written, matching media-buyer's campaign-spec; whether Meta's budget should be that figure or that figure / 1.15 (Meta adds VAT on top) is needs_human NH-BA-03. ref_code is the one-letter tier token used in payment references (needs_human NH-BA-02).
_comment_terms: terms / topup / qualified_lead: Jonathan's decisions of 2026-10-05 (deliverables/contracts-drafter/lead-generation-agreement/BRIEF.md). Read by src/lib/pricing.ts (website /pricing, proposal + invoice generators, public chatbot) and by supabase/functions/_shared/pricing.generated.ts (regenerate with `node automation/billing/gen-edge-pricing.mjs`). Prices excl. VAT; vat_registered=false means no VAT line.

terms.shortfall_after_rollover: carry balance into the next paid cycle, or refund the effective price per undelivered lead if the client does not renew
terms.late_payment: delivery suspended until paid; no interest

_comment_replacements: rows[].replacement_cap_cycle (Bronze 4 / Silver 6 / Gold 9) is the MASTER-PROMPT 0.1 per-cycle replacement cap, kept as DATA ONLY: it still seeds pricing.replacement_cap_cycle and cycles.replacement_cap, and it drives nothing and is shown to nobody. Replacements are goodwill, never a right (agreement clause 7, Jonathan 5 and 10 Oct 2026): at most terms.goodwill_replacements_per_week (3) requests per Calendar Week on EVERY plan, no-shows and unreachable ('Couldn't reach them') leads combined, each with Schedule 3 proof sent 10 to 30 minutes after the booked start. The pilot has no cap of its own either.
_comment_topup_refund: topup.price_per_lead_zar is the price BOUGHT at. An undelivered top-up lead is refunded at the Effective Lead Price of the client's plan at the time (price_zar / committed_leads rounded: Pilot R850, Bronze R825, Silver R817, Gold R789), never at the flat top-up price (Jonathan, 10 Oct 2026; agreement clauses 6.5 and 11.6). Computed by perLead() in src/lib/pricing.ts and asserted by automation/billing/pricing-refund.test.js.

pilot.name: Pilot
pilot._comment: Jonathan 2026-10-05: once-off introductory 30-day cycle, first-time clients only; price = price_per_lead_zar x committed_leads; flat fee in advance; same rollover and goodwill-replacement rules. Kept outside `rows` so the monthly ladder (checkout, W25, Paystack plans) is unchanged. media_share_zar not decided.
